title: Orientations of two rectifiable triples agree up to sign on the overlap of the carriers
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[n] on ℝ^P, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, and let (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁) and (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U n. Assume that for H-a.e. x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂ (i.e. H.restrict(M₁ ∩ M₂)-a.e.), every subspace Q that is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M₁, θ₁) at x is also a weighted approximate tangent space of (M₂, θ₂) at x. Then for H-a.e. x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂, ξ₁(x) = ξ₂(x) or ξ₁(x) = −ξ₂(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M₁ θ₁ ξ₁ → IsRectifiableTriple U n M₂ θ₂ ξ₂ → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₂ θ₂ x Q) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ξ₁ x = ξ₂ x ∨ ξ₁ x = -ξ₂ x
